tools.name: record_inspection
tools.description: Record a bounded structured inspection as part of Record Observation: stable Surface items, grounded inventory and distinct action reports commit together. First contact with a Surface/Actor/Platform/version needs inventory, explicitly empty when none was seen. Before a Product mutation save attempting with inspected preconditions and a non-secret resource reference. Only authorizedAttemptIds returned by a NEW write authorize dispatch in this host execution. Replay returns no new authority. Save an exercised outcome against its exact attempt Observation; reconcile uncertain actions by reading Product state before any repeat. No Review, Finding or Expected Behavior is created.

tools.name: record_test_checks
tools.description: Record the exact Surface-item checks a Test asserts, bound to its current file fingerprint. Each mapping names its actual Actor, Platform, conditions, native case and step, execution mode and receipt key. Run freezes these associations. A skipped, unexecuted or mocked mapped check cannot borrow a sibling case's pass. Re-recording replaces the current association set and preserves historical sets and Runs; an empty set clears current mappings. This records Test metadata and does not pin Expected Behavior or start a Run.

tools.name: read_explore
tools.description: Read bounded Surface contents, typed inspection history, derived exact check states, access hints, recovery and Scenario/Test clues from one Knowledge revision. Explicit Actor and all/unknown/exact version selection never closes another context. Recovery includes unresolved attempts across filters. Continuations are bound to selection and revision; stale continuations require restarting the read. Inspect current Product state before following recorded access hints. Counts refer only to known named scope.

tools.name: list_open_reviews
tools.description: List open Reviews of every kind that need a human Decision. A Coverage Review carries ordered Journey groups with each why and its Scenarios. A linked Create Review carries a flat source-mapped proposal. Both include every reported contradiction with the accepted Scenario's text and source feedback. Investigate Reviews include Findings and their current Decisions. Resumed Reviews link to their source. An empty list does not mean coverage is complete: deferred proposals remain in the human inbox and accepted Scenarios may still await Tests.

tools.name: start_create
tools.description: Start Create with exactly one request shape. For new coverage, send ordered Journey groups with a why and one or more Scenarios each, and no Follow-on work id. For revision or replacement work, send one pending Follow-on work id and exactly one same-Journey proposal for every source Scenario, with nothing else. Ground each new-coverage why in Observations for the relevant Actors, and compare proposals with accepted Scenarios. Report every contradiction you find. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` pins Expected Behavior.

tools.name: start_investigate
tools.description: Start Investigate from one recorded Run. Write Findings with a required body, optional selected recorded Test, optional Evidence ids, and needsJudgment. For clear encoding repairs, use record_test_change instead of a Finding. If a caller supplies a Finding with needsJudgment false, it never opens a Review. Qualifying Findings open or join the one open Investigate Review for that Run. An empty Findings list creates no Review. After a human asks for more Evidence, import it and pass linkEvidence to attach it to the unresolved Finding. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` names a layer.

needsJudgment.description: true when the Finding contradicts pinned Expected Behavior and is not a clear locator, JSONPath, wait, helper, framework, device, wiring, browser-version, or device-model repair. false records a supplied nonqualifying Finding without a Review. For clear encoding repairs use record_test_change, with no Finding.

findings.description: Findings to write for this Run; may be empty

linkEvidence.description: Attach imported Evidence to existing unresolved Findings on this Run after a human asked for more Evidence. Does not open a second Review.

findingId.description: Id of an unresolved Finding on this Run that should gain Evidence

tools.name: read_follow_on_work
tools.description: Read Follow-on work left by human Decisions. Create work includes status (pending, claimed, completed), source Scenario ids, and its claiming Review when present. Revision sources include full Scenario text and send-back history with the exact reason, optional suggested wording, ruling key, Review, human, and time. Test repair includes status (pending, completed, cancelled), causal Finding and recorded Test ids, and completion or cancellation details, and sourceFinding with the body, Run id, Evidence ids, and human Decision even after its Review resolves. Product work includes its source Finding and Run, issue associations, readiness, and verification attempts. Read this before starting any command.

tools.name: complete_test_repair
tools.description: Complete pending Test repair work after editing its recorded Test in place. Requires its active path to name a regular file. Atomically records your change explanation and the file fingerprint with completion, without approving the edit, changing Test identity or Scenario, or starting Generate or Run. Returns the existing work fields plus changeId for completed work. Use changeId with record_test_verification after a qualifying terminal check; no history lookup is needed. Retries and later completion calls return that work's original changeId, even after later Test changes. Cancelled work returns its terminal state without changeId or a repair entry. Missing or contradictory history links fail explicitly.

tools.name: prepare_product_handoff
tools.description: Read a Product Finding's ready-to-file Markdown package. Includes missing information and Evidence references; never publishes an issue or Evidence. Record package details through record_product_follow_up first when available.

tools.name: record_product_follow_up
tools.description: Record a confirmed Product Finding's package details, issue link/correction, fix-readiness report, or verification attempt. Recurrence links require supporting Evidence and reasoning, not similar text alone. Readiness requires a report of fix availability in the target environment. Then promptly use start_run. After a Test edit, promptly Run the affected Test. Verification needs a relevant passing recorded Run, supporting Evidence, and an explanation establishing original Expected Behavior and the target environment. Incomplete attempts stay pending. Never publishes externally, starts an Agent, resolves a Review, or retires a defect.

tools.name: record_test
tools.description: Record one Test you wrote for an accepted Scenario: an identity you choose that never changes, the Scenario id, and the Project-relative path of a file that already exists under tests/playwright/ (a Playwright Test) or tests/api/ (a Postman collection that Newman runs). Perquiro infers the runner from the path. Reads the file only to fingerprint its bytes, and records your initial change explanation atomically with a new Test (or a relocation entry when its path changes). Rejected, writing nothing, when the identity is blank, the Scenario is unknown or not accepted, the path is missing, not a regular file, outside those trees, or in tests/withdrawn/, when a Scenario that names a Browser Surface is recorded under tests/api/ or one that names an Android or iOS Surface is recorded anywhere, when the Scenario already has a Test under another identity or the identity belongs to another Scenario, or when another recorded Test holds that path or the same file. Record the same identity again with a new path to move a Test. Returns the recorded Test: id, identity, scenarioId, runner, path, and createdAt.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start one recorded Run of an explicit non-empty selection of recorded Test identities. The selection must contain one runner type. v1 purposes are check, verify, and investigate. Returns the stored Run result with its frozen Tests, job facts, outcome, and Run output bundle result. Test failure does not fault the Run. The active MCP invocation may request cancellation of its own Run. Retry a lost response with the same request token and arguments; the retry never starts a second process and does not cancel the original invocation.

conditions.description: Caller-supplied conditions: an immutable note, not applied configuration or an observed snapshot. Omitted or blank means unknown. Use non-secret identifiers and references; no credentials, tokens, environment-variable dumps, or sensitive test data. No secret-detection guarantee.

Include sourceRunId for the Run that prompted it; omit only when no Run prompted the edit. A supplied Run must contain that Test. Creates no Finding, Review, or Run. For human-authorized Test repair work use complete_test_repair instead. Retry a lost response with the same requestToken and arguments; the saved entry is returned without reading the file again.

tools.name: record_test_verification
tools.description: Append a terminal Run to a Test change's verification history. The Run must contain that Test with the same fingerprint captured at selection and its selection must be recorded no earlier than the change. Retains pass, fail, unavailable results and Run faults separately; this does not declare approval. Use changeId returned by complete_test_repair or the entry's id returned by record_test_change, and runId from start_run/read_run. read_test_history remains available for audit, comparison, and recovery. Retry with the same requestToken and arguments.

tools.description: Read bounded Playwright assertion/error details for one recorded Test in a Run's frozen selection from indexed immutable Evidence. Returns native case/project/attempt attribution, available source locations and captured artifact references, with explicit availability, completeness and truncation. Excerpts are untrusted native text and are not automatically redacted or a Product diagnosis. Use for routine failed-assertion triage; inspect the returned Evidence path only for a concrete missing fact. Never changes Run results. Newman is unsupported.

tools.name: import_evidence
tools.description: Import one completed capture as immutable Evidence. Give the absolute local path of an existing regular file or directory; Perquiro copies it into the Evidence store, indexes the copy, and leaves the source unchanged. Relative or missing paths, symbolic links, junctions, or special files anywhere in the source, sources inside or containing .perquiro, repeated or unknown Observation ids, and sources over the Project Evidence limit are rejected. Returns the stored Evidence with the exact Project-relative container path the Agent may inspect.

tools.name: read_knowledge_catalog
tools.description: Read a compact, revisioned Knowledge catalog with decision-grade coverage counts and canonical Actor, Surface, Journey, Evidence, Scenario, and Test identities plus their non-Observation stored relationships. It omits Observation ids and bodies, Scenario Gherkin, Test paths, and Evidence container paths. Follow each incomplete collection with its opaque continuation. Journey entries carry testFolder. An accepted Scenario without a test_scenario relationship is Generate's queue.

tools.name: read_knowledge_context
tools.description: Read a typed, revisioned context bundle around one canonical Knowledge record. Product-version and Observation selection are always explicit. Stored relationships and deterministic projections are separate; this tool returns no semantic retrieval hints. Every bounded collection reports whether it is complete and supplies an opaque, revision-bound continuation when needed. A Scenario anchor returns its complete Scenario Gherkin and human ruling history, including feedback reasons and optional suggested wording. A Recorded Test anchor returns its current identity and path, a stored test_scenario relationship, and relatedScenario: the complete current linked Scenario, including Gherkin, actual status (accepted or withdrawn), and ruling history, from the same SQLite snapshot. This current record does not establish the state or conditions of an earlier Run; read its frozen selection and any original Product Finding source snapshot separately. No unrelated Scenario records, Observation bodies, or Project-wide catalog are added by default.

tools.name: record_inspection
tools.description: Record a bounded structured inspection as part of Record Observation: stable Surface items, grounded inventory and distinct action reports commit together. First contact with a Surface/Actor/Platform/version needs inventory, explicitly empty when none was seen. Before a Product mutation save attempting with inspected preconditions and a non-secret resource reference. Only authorizedAttemptIds returned by a NEW write authorize dispatch in this host execution. Replay returns no new authority. Save an exercised outcome against its exact attempt Observation; reconcile uncertain actions by reading Product state before any repeat. No Review, Finding or Expected Behavior is created.

tools.name: record_test_checks
tools.description: Record the exact Surface-item checks a Test asserts, bound to its current file fingerprint. Each mapping names its actual Actor, Platform, conditions, native case and step, execution mode and receipt key. Run freezes these associations. A skipped, unexecuted or mocked mapped check cannot borrow a sibling case's pass. Re-recording replaces the current association set and preserves historical sets and Runs; an empty set clears current mappings. This records Test metadata and does not pin Expected Behavior or start a Run.

tools.name: read_explore
tools.description: Read bounded Surface contents, typed inspection history, derived exact check states, access hints, recovery and Scenario/Test clues from one Knowledge revision. Explicit Actor and all/unknown/exact version selection never closes another context. Recovery includes unresolved attempts across filters. Continuations are bound to selection and revision; stale continuations require restarting the read. Inspect current Product state before following recorded access hints. Counts refer only to known named scope.

tools.name: list_open_reviews
tools.description: List open Reviews of every kind that need a human Decision. A Coverage Review carries ordered Journey groups with each why and its Scenarios. A linked Create Review carries a flat source-mapped proposal. Both include every reported contradiction with the accepted Scenario's text and source feedback. Investigate Reviews include Findings and their current Decisions. Resumed Reviews link to their source. An empty list does not mean coverage is complete: deferred proposals remain in the human inbox and accepted Scenarios may still await Tests.

tools.name: start_create
tools.description: Start Create with exactly one request shape. For new coverage, send ordered Journey groups with a why and one or more Scenarios each, and no Follow-on work id. For revision or replacement work, send one pending Follow-on work id and exactly one same-Journey proposal for every source Scenario, with nothing else. Ground each new-coverage why in Observations for the relevant Actors, and compare proposals with accepted Scenarios. Report every contradiction you find. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` pins Expected Behavior.

tools.name: start_investigate
tools.description: Start Investigate from one recorded Run. Write Findings with a required body, optional selected recorded Test, optional Evidence ids, and needsJudgment. For clear encoding repairs, use record_test_change instead of a Finding. If a caller supplies a Finding with needsJudgment false, it never opens a Review. Qualifying Findings open or join the one open Investigate Review for that Run. An empty Findings list creates no Review. After a human asks for more Evidence, import it and pass linkEvidence to attach it to the unresolved Finding. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` names a layer.

For clear encoding repairs use record_test_change, with no Finding.

linkEvidence.description: Attach imported Evidence to existing unresolved Findings on this Run after a human asked for more Evidence. Does not open a second Review.

tools.name: read_follow_on_work
tools.description: Read Follow-on work left by human Decisions. Create work includes status (pending, claimed, completed), source Scenario ids, and its claiming Review when present. Revision sources include full Scenario text and send-back history with the exact reason, optional suggested wording, ruling key, Review, human, and time. Test repair includes status (pending, completed, cancelled), causal Finding and recorded Test ids, and completion or cancellation details, and sourceFinding with the body, Run id, Evidence ids, and human Decision even after its Review resolves. Product work includes its source Finding and Run, issue associations, readiness, and verification attempts. Read this before starting any command.

tools.name: complete_test_repair
tools.description: Complete pending Test repair work after editing its recorded Test in place. Requires its active path to name a regular file. Atomically records your change explanation and the file fingerprint with completion, without approving the edit, changing Test identity or Scenario, or starting Generate or Run. Returns the existing work fields plus changeId for completed work. Use changeId with record_test_verification after a qualifying terminal check; no history lookup is needed. Retries and later completion calls return that work's original changeId, even after later Test changes. Cancelled work returns its terminal state without changeId or a repair entry. Missing or contradictory history links fail explicitly.

tools.name: prepare_product_handoff
tools.description: Read a Product Finding's ready-to-file Markdown package. Includes missing information and Evidence references; never publishes an issue or Evidence. Record package details through record_product_follow_up first when available.

tools.name: record_product_follow_up
tools.description: Record a confirmed Product Finding's package details, issue link/correction, fix-readiness report, or verification attempt. Recurrence links require supporting Evidence and reasoning, not similar text alone. Readiness requires a report of fix availability in the target environment. Then promptly use start_run. After a Test edit, promptly Run the affected Test. Verification needs a relevant passing recorded Run, supporting Evidence, and an explanation establishing original Expected Behavior and the target environment. Incomplete attempts stay pending. Never publishes externally, starts an Agent, resolves a Review, or retires a defect.

tools.name: record_test
tools.description: Record one Test you wrote for an accepted Scenario: an identity you choose that never changes, the Scenario id, and the Project-relative path of a file that already exists under tests/playwright/ (a Playwright Test) or tests/api/ (a Postman collection that Newman runs). Perquiro infers the runner from the path. Reads the file only to fingerprint its bytes, and records your initial change explanation atomically with a new Test (or a relocation entry when its path changes). Rejected, writing nothing, when the identity is blank, the Scenario is unknown or not accepted, the path is missing, not a regular file, outside those trees, or in tests/withdrawn/, when a Scenario that names a Browser Surface is recorded under tests/api/ or one that names an Android or iOS Surface is recorded anywhere, when the Scenario already has a Test under another identity or the identity belongs to another Scenario, or when another recorded Test holds that path or the same file. Record the same identity again with a new path to move a Test. Returns the recorded Test: id, identity, scenarioId, runner, path, and createdAt.

Returns the stored Run result with its frozen Tests, job facts, outcome, and Run output bundle result. Test failure does not fault the Run. The active MCP invocation may request cancellation of its own Run. Retry a lost response with the same request token and arguments; the retry never starts a second process and does not cancel the original invocation.

Stored relationships and deterministic projections are separate; this tool returns no semantic retrieval hints. Every bounded collection reports whether it is complete and supplies an opaque, revision-bound continuation when needed. A Scenario anchor returns its complete Scenario Gherkin and human ruling history, including feedback reasons and optional suggested wording. A Recorded Test anchor returns its current identity and path, a stored test_scenario relationship, and relatedScenario: the complete current linked Scenario, including Gherkin, actual status (accepted or withdrawn), and ruling history, from the same SQLite snapshot. This current record does not establish the state or conditions of an earlier Run; read its frozen selection and any original Product Finding source snapshot separately. No unrelated Scenario records, Observation bodies, or Project-wide catalog are added by default.

tools.name: record_inspection
tools.description: Record a bounded structured inspection as part of Record Observation: stable Surface items, grounded inventory and distinct action reports commit together. First contact with a Surface/Actor/Platform/version needs inventory, explicitly empty when none was seen. Before a Product mutation save attempting with inspected preconditions and a non-secret resource reference. Only authorizedAttemptIds returned by a NEW write authorize dispatch in this host execution. Replay returns no new authority. Save an exercised outcome against its exact attempt Observation; reconcile uncertain actions by reading Product state before any repeat. No Review, Finding or Expected Behavior is created.

tools.name: record_test_checks
tools.description: Record the exact Surface-item checks a Test asserts, bound to its current file fingerprint. Each mapping names its actual Actor, Platform, conditions, native case and step, execution mode and receipt key. Run freezes these associations. A skipped, unexecuted or mocked mapped check cannot borrow a sibling case's pass. Re-recording replaces the current association set and preserves historical sets and Runs; an empty set clears current mappings. This records Test metadata and does not pin Expected Behavior or start a Run.

tools.name: read_explore
tools.description: Read bounded Surface contents, typed inspection history, derived exact check states, access hints, recovery and Scenario/Test clues from one Knowledge revision. Explicit Actor and all/unknown/exact version selection never closes another context. Recovery includes unresolved attempts across filters. Continuations are bound to selection and revision; stale continuations require restarting the read. Inspect current Product state before following recorded access hints. Counts refer only to known named scope.

tools.name: list_open_reviews
tools.description: List open Reviews of every kind that need a human Decision. A Coverage Review carries ordered Journey groups with each why and its Scenarios. A linked Create Review carries a flat source-mapped proposal. Both include every reported contradiction with the accepted Scenario's text and source feedback. Investigate Reviews include Findings and their current Decisions. Resumed Reviews link to their source. An empty list does not mean coverage is complete: deferred proposals remain in the human inbox and accepted Scenarios may still await Tests.

tools.name: start_create
tools.description: Start Create with exactly one request shape. For new coverage, send ordered Journey groups with a why and one or more Scenarios each, and no Follow-on work id. For revision or replacement work, send one pending Follow-on work id and exactly one same-Journey proposal for every source Scenario, with nothing else. Ground each new-coverage why in Observations for the relevant Actors, and compare proposals with accepted Scenarios. Report every contradiction you find. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` pins Expected Behavior.

tools.name: start_investigate
tools.description: Start Investigate from one recorded Run. Write Findings with a required body, optional selected recorded Test, optional Evidence ids, and needsJudgment. For clear encoding repairs, use record_test_change instead of a Finding. If a caller supplies a Finding with needsJudgment false, it never opens a Review. Qualifying Findings open or join the one open Investigate Review for that Run. An empty Findings list creates no Review. After a human asks for more Evidence, import it and pass linkEvidence to attach it to the unresolved Finding. Only a human Decision through `perquiro review` names a layer.

runId.description: Id of the recorded Run this Investigate starts from

recordedTestId.description: Id of one recorded Test selected on the Run. Omit only for a Run-level Finding.

needsJudgment.description: true when the Finding contradicts pinned Expected Behavior and is not a clear locator, JSONPath, wait, helper, framework, device, wiring, browser-version, or device-model repair. false records a supplied nonqualifying Finding without a Review. For clear encoding repairs use record_test_change, with no Finding.

findings.description: Findings to write for this Run; may be empty

linkEvidence.description: Attach imported Evidence to existing unresolved Findings on this Run after a human asked for more Evidence. Does not open a second Review.

findingId.description: Id of an unresolved Finding on this Run that should gain Evidence

evidenceIds.description: Ids of Evidence already imported for that Finding

tools.name: read_follow_on_work
tools.description: Read Follow-on work left by human Decisions. Create work includes status (pending, claimed, completed), source Scenario ids, and its claiming Review when present. Revision sources include full Scenario text and send-back history with the exact reason, optional suggested wording, ruling key, Review, human, and time. Test repair includes status (pending, completed, cancelled), causal Finding and recorded Test ids, and completion or cancellation details, and sourceFinding with the body, Run id, Evidence ids, and human Decision even after its Review resolves. Product work includes its source Finding and Run, issue associations, readiness, and verification attempts. Read this before starting any command.

tools.name: complete_test_repair
tools.description: Complete pending Test repair work after editing its recorded Test in place. Requires its active path to name a regular file. Atomically records your change explanation and the file fingerprint with completion, without approving the edit, changing Test identity or Scenario, or starting Generate or Run. Returns the existing work fields plus changeId for completed work. Use changeId with record_test_verification after a qualifying terminal check; no history lookup is needed. Retries and later completion calls return that work's original changeId, even after later Test changes. Cancelled work returns its terminal state without changeId or a repair entry. Missing or contradictory history links fail explicitly.

tools.name: prepare_product_handoff
tools.description: Read a Product Finding's ready-to-file Markdown package. Includes missing information and Evidence references; never publishes an issue or Evidence. Record package details through record_product_follow_up first when available.

tools.name: record_product_follow_up
tools.description: Record a confirmed Product Finding's package details, issue link/correction, fix-readiness report, or verification attempt. Recurrence links require supporting Evidence and reasoning, not similar text alone. Readiness requires a report of fix availability in the target environment. Then promptly use start_run. After a Test edit, promptly Run the affected Test. Verification needs a relevant passing recorded Run, supporting Evidence, and an explanation establishing original Expected Behavior and the target environment. Incomplete attempts stay pending. Never publishes externally, starts an Agent, resolves a Review, or retires a defect.

tools.name: record_test
tools.description: Record one Test you wrote for an accepted Scenario: an identity you choose that never changes, the Scenario id, and the Project-relative path of a file that already exists under tests/playwright/ (a Playwright Test) or tests/api/ (a Postman collection that Newman runs). Perquiro infers the runner from the path. Reads the file only to fingerprint its bytes, and records your initial change explanation atomically with a new Test (or a relocation entry when its path changes). Rejected, writing nothing, when the identity is blank, the Scenario is unknown or not accepted, the path is missing, not a regular file, outside those trees, or in tests/withdrawn/, when a Scenario that names a Browser Surface is recorded under tests/api/ or one that names an Android or iOS Surface is recorded anywhere, when the Scenario already has a Test under another identity or the identity belongs to another Scenario, or when another recorded Test holds that path or the same file. Record the same identity again with a new path to move a Test. Returns the recorded Test: id, identity, scenarioId, runner, path, and createdAt.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start one recorded Run of an explicit non-empty selection of recorded Test identities. The selection must contain one runner type. v1 purposes are check, verify, and investigate. Returns the stored Run result with its frozen Tests, job facts, outcome, and Run output bundle result. Test failure does not fault the Run. The active MCP invocation may request cancellation of its own Run. Retry a lost response with the same request token and arguments; the retry never starts a second process and does not cancel the original invocation.

conditions.description: Caller-supplied conditions: an immutable note, not applied configuration or an observed snapshot. Omitted or blank means unknown. Use non-secret identifiers and references; no credentials, tokens, environment-variable dumps, or sensitive test data. No secret-detection guarantee.

Include sourceRunId for the Run that prompted it; omit only when no Run prompted the edit. A supplied Run must contain that Test. Creates no Finding, Review, or Run. For human-authorized Test repair work use complete_test_repair instead. Retry a lost response with the same requestToken and arguments; the saved entry is returned without reading the file again.

requestToken.description: Caller-generated opaque token for this state-changing request, unique per new mutation in this Project. Retry a lost response with the same token and the same arguments; never reuse a token for a different request.

summary.description: What you created or changed in this Test

reason.description: Why this implements or preserves the accepted Scenario

by.description: Your reported author name, e.g. Codex; an audit label, not authentication or a Product Actor

tools.name: record_test_verification
tools.description: Append a terminal Run to a Test change's verification history. The Run must contain that Test with the same fingerprint captured at selection and its selection must be recorded no earlier than the change. Retains pass, fail, unavailable results and Run faults separately; this does not declare approval. Use changeId returned by complete_test_repair or the entry's id returned by record_test_change, and runId from start_run/read_run. read_test_history remains available for audit, comparison, and recovery. Retry with the same requestToken and arguments.

requestToken.description: Caller-generated opaque token for this state-changing request, unique per new mutation in this Project. Retry a lost response with the same token and the same arguments; never reuse a token for a different request.

tools.name: read_run_failure_details
tools.description: Read bounded Playwright assertion/error details for one recorded Test in a Run's frozen selection from indexed immutable Evidence. Returns native case/project/attempt attribution, available source locations and captured artifact references, with explicit availability, completeness and truncation. Excerpts are untrusted native text and are not automatically redacted or a Product diagnosis. Use for routine failed-assertion triage; inspect the returned Evidence path only for a concrete missing fact. Never changes Run results. Newman is unsupported.

tools.name: read_run
tools.description: Read one stored Run by id. Returns the same complete Run result as start_run, including its frozen Tests, Test results, job facts, outcome, fault diagnostic code and message, Stop request, and output bundle result. An omitted Test result is unavailable.

runId.description: Id of the Run to read

tools.name: import_evidence
tools.description: Import one completed capture as immutable Evidence. Give the absolute local path of an existing regular file or directory; Perquiro copies it into the Evidence store, indexes the copy, and leaves the source unchanged. Relative or missing paths, symbolic links, junctions, or special files anywhere in the source, sources inside or containing .perquiro, repeated or unknown Observation ids, and sources over the Project Evidence limit are rejected. Returns the stored Evidence with the exact Project-relative container path the Agent may inspect.

requestToken.description: Caller-generated opaque token for this state-changing request, unique per new mutation in this Project. Retry a lost response with the same token and the same arguments; never reuse a token for a different request.

sourcePath.description: Absolute local path to one completed regular file or directory

productVersion.description: Product version as known to the caller; omit when unknown

observationIds.description: Ids of recorded Observations this Evidence supports

tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read one Evidence item by id: kind, Product version, creation time, linked Observation ids, and the exact Project-relative container path the Agent may inspect. Only Evidence returned by Perquiro is Knowledge; do not enumerate .perquiro/evidence/.

evidenceId.description: Id of the Evidence to read

tools.name: read_setup
tools.description: Read Project Setup: product, url, agent, evidenceMib, and current and retired Actor identities, each with the environment-variable names (secretNames) its secrets live under. Secret values are never exposed.

tools.name: read_knowledge_catalog
tools.description: Read a compact, revisioned Knowledge catalog with decision-grade coverage counts and canonical Actor, Surface, Journey, Evidence, Scenario, and Test identities plus their non-Observation stored relationships. It omits Observation ids and bodies, Scenario Gherkin, Test paths, and Evidence container paths. Follow each incomplete collection with its opaque continuation. Journey entries carry testFolder. An accepted Scenario without a test_scenario relationship is Generate's queue.

tools.name: read_knowledge_context
tools.description: Read a typed, revisioned context bundle around one canonical Knowledge record. Product-version and Observation selection are always explicit. Stored relationships and deterministic projections are separate; this tool returns no semantic retrieval hints. Every bounded collection reports whether it is complete and supplies an opaque, revision-bound continuation when needed. A Scenario anchor returns its complete Scenario Gherkin and human ruling history, including feedback reasons and optional suggested wording. A Recorded Test anchor returns its current identity and path, a stored test_scenario relationship, and relatedScenario: the complete current linked Scenario, including Gherkin, actual status (accepted or withdrawn), and ruling history, from the same SQLite snapshot. This current record does not establish the state or conditions of an earlier Run; read its frozen selection and any original Product Finding source snapshot separately. No unrelated Scenario records, Observation bodies, or Project-wide catalog are added by default.

anchor.description: Canonical Knowledge record kind and id to read

productVersions.description: All versions, unknown version, or one or more exact opaque values

observations.description: No Observations, grouped summaries, or grouped records for named Actors and scope
